title: Completed and rational tensor-Hom transpose bijection
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $X$, and a finite coefficient field $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with $R=\mathcal O_E$. Use the derived-complete bounded constructible integral category $D^b_c(X,R)$ of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], its completed coefficient sheaf $\widehat R_X$, and the tensor, internal Hom and evaluation operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Let $P,L,Q\in D^b_c(X,R)$ and assume $H(P,Q)=R\mathcal Hom_{\widehat R_X}(P,Q)$ belongs to $D^b_c(X,R)$. Write $e_{P,Q}:P\widehat\otimes_R^L H(P,Q)\to Q$ for evaluation. Then the map
$$\operatorname{Hom}(L,H(P,Q))\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}(P\widehat\otimes_R^L L,Q),\qquad \varphi\longmapsto e_{P,Q}\circ(1_P\widehat\otimes_R^L\varphi)$$
is an $R$-linear bijection, natural in all three variables on the indicated domains and compatible with the signed tensor symmetry. In the raw rationalization $D^b_c(X,E)$ of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], for the images of these objects and operations the same evaluation formula gives a natural $E$-linear bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}(L,R\mathcal Hom_E(P,Q))\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}(P\otimes_E^L L,Q).$$
This rational bijection applies to arbitrary morphisms in the rationalized Hom groups, and retains the naturality and symmetry compatibility.
